classes.name: IGESDefs_AssociativityDef
classes.summary: defines IGES Associativity Definition Entity, Type <302> Form <5001 - 9999> in package {@link IGESDefs | `IGESDefs`}. This class permits the preprocessor to define an associativity schema. i.e., by using it preprocessor defines the type of relationship.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (requirements: NCollection_HArray1_int, orders: NCollection_HArray1_int, numItems: NCollection_HArray1_int, items: IGESBasic_HArray1OfHArray1OfInteger): void
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class AssociativityDef.
- requirements : Back Pointers requirements
- orders : Class Orders
- numItems : Number of Items per Class
- items : Items in each class raises exception if lengths of the arrays are not the same.

instanceMethods.name: NbClassDefs
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Number of class definitions

instanceMethods.name: IsBackPointerReq
instanceMethods.comment: returns 1 if the theBackPointerReqs(ClassNum) = 1 returns 0 if the theBackPointerReqs(ClassNum) = 2 raises exception if ClassNum <= 0 or ClassNum > `NbClassDefs()`

instanceMethods.name: BackPointerReq
instanceMethods.comment: returns 1 or 2 raises exception if ClassNum <= 0 or ClassNum > `NbClassDefs()`

instanceMethods.name: IsOrdered
instanceMethods.comment: returns 1 if theClassOrders(ClassNum) = 1 (ordered class) returns 0 if theClassOrders(ClassNum) = 2 (unordered class) raises exception if ClassNum <= 0 or ClassNum > `NbClassDefs()`

instanceMethods.name: ClassOrder
instanceMethods.comment: returns 1 or 2 raises exception if ClassNum <= 0 or ClassNum > `NbClassDefs()`

instanceMethods.name: NbItemsPerClass
instanceMethods.comment: returns no. of items per class entry raises exception if ClassNum <= 0 or ClassNum > `NbClassDefs()`

instanceMethods.name: Item
instanceMethods.comment: returns ItemNum'th Item of ClassNum'th Class raises exception if ClassNum <= 0 or ClassNum > `NbClassDefs()` ItemNum <= 0 or ItemNum > NbItemsPerClass(ClassNum)

classes.name: IGESDefs_AttributeDef
classes.summary: defines IGES Attribute Table Definition Entity, Type <322> Form [0, 1, 2] in package {@link IGESDefs | `IGESDefs`}. This is class is used to support the concept of well defined collection of attributes, whether it is a table or a single row of attributes.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (aName: TCollection_HAsciiString, aListType: number, attrTypes: NCollection_HArray1_int, attrValueDataTypes: NCollection_HArray1_int, attrValueCounts: NCollection_HArray1_int, attrValues: NCollection_HArray1_handle_Standard_Transient, attrValuePointers: IGESDefs_HArray1OfHArray1OfTextDisplayTemplate): void

instanceMethods.name: HasTableName
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if a Table Name is defined.

instanceMethods.name: TableName
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Attribute Table name, or comment (default = null, no name : seeHasTableName)

instanceMethods.name: ListType
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Attribute List Type

instanceMethods.name: NbAttributes
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Number of Attributes

instanceMethods.name: AttributeType
instanceMethods.comment: returns the num'th Attribute Type raises exception if num <= 0 or num > `NbAttributes()`

instanceMethods.name: AttributeValueDataType
instanceMethods.comment: returns the num'th Attribute value data type raises exception if num <= 0 or num > `NbAttributes()`

instanceMethods.name: AttributeValueCount
instanceMethods.comment: returns the num'th Attribute value count raises exception if num <= 0 or num > `NbAttributes()`

instanceMethods.name: HasValues
instanceMethods.comment: returns false if Values are defined (i.e. for Form = 1 or 2)

instanceMethods.name: HasTextDisplay
instanceMethods.comment: returns false if TextDisplays are defined (i.e. for Form = 2)

instanceMethods.name: AttributeList
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the List of Attributes <AttrNum>, as a Transient. Its effective Type depends of the Type of Attribute : HArray1OfInteger for Integer, Logical(0-1), HArray1OfReal for Real, HArray1OfHSaciiString for String, HArray1OfIGESEntity for Entity (Pointer) See methods AttributeAs... for an accurate access.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsInteger
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AttrNum, rank ValueNum> as an Integer Error if Indices out of Range, or no Value defined, or not an Integer.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsReal
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AttrNum, rank ValueNum> as a Real Error if Indices out of Range, or no Value defined, or not a Real.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsString
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AttrNum, rank ValueNum> as an Integer.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AttrNum, rank ValueNum> as an Entity Error if Indices out of Range, or no Value defined, or not a Entity.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsLogical
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AttrNum, rank ValueNum> as a Boolean Error if Indices out of Range, or no Value defined, or not a Logical.

classes.name: IGESDefs_AttributeTable
classes.summary: defines IGES Attribute Table, Type <422> Form <0, 1> in package {@link IGESDefs | `IGESDefs`} This class is used to represent an occurrence of Attribute Table. This Class may be independent or dependent or pointed at by other Entities.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class AttributeTable.
- attributes : Attribute instances, created as (1,NbAttributes,1,NbRows)
- NbRows = 1 is a particular case (Form 0)

instanceMethods.name: SetDefinition
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a Definition as Structure information (works by calling InitMisc).

instanceMethods.name: Definition
instanceMethods.comment: Return the Structure information in Directory Entry, casted as an AttributeDef.

instanceMethods.name: NbRows
instanceMethods.comment: returns Number of Rows. Remark that it is always 1 if Form = 0 It means that the list of Attributes (by their number, and for each one its type and ValueCount) is repeated <NbRows> times

instanceMethods.name: NbAttributes
instanceMethods.comment: returns Number of Attributes

instanceMethods.name: DataType
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Type of an Attribute, given its No. : it is read in the Definition. (1 : Integer, 2 : Real, 3 : String, 4 : Entity, 6 : Logical)

instanceMethods.name: ValueCount
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Count of Value for an Attribute, given its No. : it is read in the Definition.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsInteger
instanceMethods.signature: (AtNum: number, Rownum: number, ValNum: number): number
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AtNum, Rownum, rank ValNum> as an Integer Error if Indices out of Range, or no Value defined, or not an Integer.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsReal
instanceMethods.signature: (AtNum: number, Rownum: number, ValNum: number): number
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AtNum, Rownum, rank ValNum> as a Real Error if Indices out of Range, or no Value defined, or not a Real.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsString
instanceMethods.signature: (AtNum: number, Rownum: number, ValNum: number): TCollection_HAsciiString
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AtNum, Rownum, rank ValNum> as an Integer.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsEntity
instanceMethods.signature: (AtNum: number, Rownum: number, ValNum: number): IGESData_IGESEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AtNum, Rownum, rank ValNum> as an Entity Error if Indices out of Range, or no Value defined, or not an Entity.

instanceMethods.name: AttributeAsLogical
instanceMethods.signature: (AtNum: number, Rownum: number, ValNum: number): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Attribute Value <AtNum, Rownum, rank ValNum> as a Boolean Error if Indices out of Range, or no Value defined, or not a Logical.

classes.name: IGESDefs_UnitsData
classes.summary: defines IGES UnitsData Entity, Type <316> Form <0> in package {@link IGESDefs | `IGESDefs`} This class stores data about a model's fundamental units.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class UnitsData.
- unitTypes : Types of the units being defined
- unitValues : Unit Values of the units
- unitScales : Multiplicative Scale Factors raises exception if lengths of unitTypes, unitValues and unitScale are not same

instanceMethods.name: NbUnits
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Number of units defined by this entity

instanceMethods.name: UnitType
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Type of the UnitNum'th unit being defined raises exception if UnitNum <= 0 or UnitNum > `NbUnits()`

instanceMethods.name: UnitValue
instanceMethods.comment: returns the {@link Units | `Units`} of the UnitNum'th unit being defined raises exception if UnitNum <= 0 or UnitNum > `NbUnits()`

instanceMethods.name: ScaleFactor
instanceMethods.comment: returns the multiplicative scale factor to be applied to the UnitNum'th unit being defined raises exception if UnitNum <= 0 or UnitNum > `NbUnits()`
